Set my heart on fire
Fill me with the Holy Ghost
And God’s full desire
Make me like the Christ of old
Healing and raising the dead
Give me the power that Jesus had

That makes the demons tremble
It's the life behind the name
That makes the proud heart humble
It was God who devised the plan
That in all things as a man
He could live, so He could give
Give us the life behind the name

And His righteousness
And all these things shall be added unto you
Hallelu, Hallelujah!

Seek, and you shall find
Knock, and it shall be opened unto you
Hallelu, Hallelujah!

My Word abides in you
Ye shall ask all you will
And it shall be done unto you
Hallelu, Hallelujah!

Hallelu, Hallelujah!

Hallelu, Hallelujah!

I love Him, He gives me victory
Many people doubt Him
But I can't live without Him
That is why I love Him so
He is so real to me

Clothed in majesty
Let all the Earth rejoice
All the Earth rejoice
He wraps himself in light
And darkness tries to hide

Trembles at His voice

How great is our God
Sing with me
How great is our God
And all will see How great
How great is our God

Now, I believe…

C’est la cité où l’Agneau est la Lumière
Dans cette cité où l’Agneau est la Lumière

Je m’en irai où l’Agneau est la Lumière

There’s a city where there never comes a night
If we’re faithful we shall go there by and by
It's the city where the Lamb is the light.

In that city where the Lamb is the light
In that city where there cometh no night
I’ve a mansion over there

I'm going where the Lamb is the light

I sing out a love song to Jesus

I lift up my hands to the Lord

Singing I love You Lord

Singing I love You Lord
I love You

and we cannot understand
All the ways that God would lead us
to that blessed Promised Land

and we'll follow till we die

Where the rivers cannot overflow me
Where my feet are on the rock

Fire cannot burn me

You have always been my friend
Yes, I will love You forever

You endured hostility
You drank the cup of the Father
While I was still Your enemy
Refrain
Pour out Your Spirit (x3) on me
I need Your Spirit (x3) in me

When I was broken in my sin
You brought Your Spirit upon me
And put a new heart within
4. Oh may my life burn as an offering

For You are always by my side
I will proclaim that You are faithful

I feel Him in my hands
I feel Him in my feet

There's no reason to doubt

All I ask is to be like Him

songs.title: Etre comme Toi
fr: Jésus, Je veux être comme Toi
en: Make me more like Thee
Jesus, Make me more like Thee
Give me a heart that’s filled with love
And make me more like Thee

songs.title: Father, let the fire fall
fr: Comme au jour de la Pentecôte
en: Father, let the fire fall (2x)
Let the fire fall (2x)
Let the Pentecost fire fall

songs.title: Grâce infinie de notre Dieu
fr: 2. Quand tombera cette robe de chair
Une vie de joie et paix
en: 1. Amazing grace, How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost but now am found
Was blind but now I see
2. Yes, when this flesh and heart shall fail
And mortal life shall cease
I shall possess, within the veil
A life of joy and peace
Refrain
Praise God… Praise God
Hallelujah… Amen

songs.title: Grâce infinie qui m'a sauvé
en: Amazing grace, How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost but now am found
Was blind but now I see

songs.title: Jésus est vivant
fr: Le péché et la mort sont vaincus
en: Jesus is alive (2x)
Sin and death must go, They are conquered
For Jesus is alive

songs.title: Mon Dieu est un Dieu Puissant
fr: Mon Dieu est un Dieu puissant
Il règne de son saint lieu
Oui Dieu est un Dieu puissant
en: Our God is an awesome God
He reigns from Heaven above
With wisdom, power and love
Our God is an awesome God

songs.title: Mon Dieu peut faire toute chose
fr: Mon Dieu peut faire toutes choses
Mon Dieu peut faire toutes choses pour moi
Mon Dieu peut faire toutes choses pour moi
en: My God can do anything
Anything, anything
My God can do anything for me
He's the Alpha, the Omega
The Beginning and the End
My God can do anything for me

songs.title: Nous Te bénissons Dieu Tout-Puissant
fr: Que ton règne s'établisse sur la terre,
Que tes œuvres proclament ta grandeur] (2x)
Nous te bénissons, Dieu tout puissant,
Tu es vivant et tu reviens.
Nous te bénissons, Dieu tout puissant,
en: [Father in Heaven how we love You
We lift Your Name in all the earth
May Your Kingdom be established in our praises
As Your people declare Your mighty works] (2x)
Refrain
Blessed be the Lord God Almighty
Who was and is and is to come
Blessed be the Lord God Almighty
Who reigns forevermore

songs.title: Oh Comme je L'aime
fr: Un homme de douleur et d'agonie
Le grand Créateur devenu mon Sauveur
en: Down from His glory
Ever living story
My God and Savior came
And Jesus was His name
Born in a manger
To His own a stranger
A Man of sorrows, tears and agony
Refrain
O how I love Him
O How I adore Him
My breath, my Sunshine
My all in all
The great Creator became my Savior
And all God’s fulness dwelleth in Him

songs.title: Père, unis-nous
fr: Que le monde sache que Tu es venu
en: Father, make us one (2x)
That the world may know That thou sent Thy son
Father, make us one

songs.title: Pour cet immense bonheur
fr: Que tu as mis dans mon cœur, alléluia !
Je veux te chanter Seigneur, alléluia !
Oui, Jésus est mon Sauveur, alléluia !
Que pour moi, Jésus est mort, alléluia !
Lui seul est tout mon trésor, alléluia !
3. Que chaque jour, à chaque heure, alléluia !
En moi tu aies ta demeure, alléluia !
Que ma vie soit une fleur, alléluia !
Un parfum pour toi, Seigneur, alléluia !

songs.title: Remplis-moi
en: Fill me now (2x)
Jesus come and fill me now
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence
Come, O come and fill me now

songs.title: Tire-moi plus près
fr: Qui me parle d'un ton si doux,
Mon désir Seigneur, c'est de Te servir
C'est le désir de mon cœur
2. Consacre-moi Seigneur à Ton saint service
Par la puissance de Ta grâce
Que mon âme n'espère en nul autre que Toi
en: 1. I am Thine, O Lord,
I have heard Thy voice
And it told Thy love to me
But I ling to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee
Refrain
Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord
To the cross where thou hast died
Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord
To thy precious bleeding side
2. Consecrate me now to Thy service Lord
By the power of your grace divine
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope
And my will be lost in Thine
